items.source:
If no method name pattern is given, the pointcut matches all control flows
below the given class.
items.translation: 如果未指定方法名模式，该切入点将匹配给定类下方的所有控制流。

items.source: clazz - the class
items.translation: clazz - 类

items.source: Increment the evaluation count.
items.translation: 递增评估计数。

items.source: methodNamePatterns - the method name patterns (potentially empty)
items.translation: methodNamePatterns - 方法名模式（可能为空）

items.source: methodName - the method name to check
items.translation: methodName - 要检查的方法名

items.source: The default implementation retrieves the method name pattern from methodNamePatterns and delegates to isMatch(String, String).
items.translation: 默认实现从methodNamePatterns获取方法名模式，并委托给isMatch(String, String)。

items.source: The default implementation checks for direct equality as well as xxx*, *xxx, *xxx*, and xxx*yyy matches.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查直接相等以及 `xxx*`、`*xxx`、`*xxx*` 和 `xxx*yyy` 的匹配。

items.source: Each configured method name pattern can be an exact method name or a pattern (see isMatch(String, String) for details on the supported pattern styles).
items.translation: 每个配置的方法名模式可以是确切的方法名，也可以是模式（有关支持的模式样式详情，请参阅 isMatch(String, String)）。

items.source: This method is invoked by matches(Method, Class, Object...).
items.translation: 此方法由matches(Method, Class, Object...)调用。

items.source: This method is invoked by isMatch(String, int).
items.translation: 此方法由isMatch(String, int)调用。

items.source: The default implementation always returns true.
items.translation: 默认实现始终返回true。

items.source:
Note that evaluating such pointcuts is 10-15 times slower than evaluating
normal pointcuts, but they are useful in some cases.
items.translation: 注意，评估此类点切面比评估普通点切面慢 10-15 倍，但在某些情况下它们很有用。

items.source: Useful for optimization and testing purposes.
items.translation: 适用于优化和测试目的。

items.source:
Can be overridden in subclasses — for example, to support
regular expressions.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写——例如，以支持正则表达式。

items.source:
Can be overridden in subclasses — for example, to support a
different style of simple pattern matching.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写——例如，以支持不同风格的简单模式匹配。

items.source: Get the number of times matches(Method, Class, Object...) has been evaluated.
items.translation: 获取 `matches(Method, Class, Object...)` 被评估的次数。

items.source: The class against which to match.
items.translation: 要匹配的类。

items.source: An immutable list of distinct method name patterns against which to match.
items.translation: 一个用于匹配的互斥方法名称模式列表。

items.source: Construct a new pointcut that matches all control flows below the given class.
items.translation: 构建一个新的切点，以匹配给定类下方的所有控制流。

items.source:
Construct a new pointcut that matches all calls below a method matching
one of the given method name patterns in the given class.
items.translation: 构建一个新的切点，以匹配在给定类中匹配给定方法名模式之一的方法下方的所有调用。

items.source: Return the ClassFilter for this pointcut.
items.translation: 返回该切面的 ClassFilter。

items.source: Return the MethodMatcher for this pointcut.
items.translation: 返回该切点的 MethodMatcher。

items.source: methodNamePattern - the method name pattern (may be null)
items.translation: methodNamePattern - 方法名模式（可为 null）

items.source: method - the candidate method
items.translation: method - 候选方法

items.source: targetClass - the target class
items.translation: targetClass - 目标类

items.source: patternIndex - the index of the method name pattern
items.translation: patternIndex - 方法名模式的索引

items.source: true if the method name matches the pattern at the specified index
items.translation: true 如果方法名匹配指定索引处的模式

items.source: methodNamePattern - the method name pattern
items.translation: methodNamePattern - 方法名模式

items.source: true if the method name matches the pattern
items.translation: true 如果方法名匹配该模式。

items.source: This method is invoked only if MethodMatcher.matches(Method, Class) returns true for the given method and target class, and if MethodMatcher.isRuntime() returns true.
items.translation: 此方法仅在 `MethodMatcher.matches(Method, Class)` 对给定方法和目标类返回`true`，且`MethodMatcher.isRuntime()` 返回 `true` 时被调用。

items.source:
Can be invoked when an AOP proxy is created, and need not be invoked
again before each method invocation.
items.translation: 可在创建 AOP 代理时调用，无需在每次方法调用前再次调用。

items.source:
Invoked immediately before potential running of the advice, after any
advice earlier in the advice chain has run.
items.translation: 在潜在运行建议之前立即调用，且在建议链中任何较早的建议运行之后。

items.source: Is this MethodMatcher dynamic, that is, must a final check be made via the MethodMatcher.matches(Method, Class, Object[]) method at runtime even if MethodMatcher.matches(Method, Class) returns true?
items.translation: 这个 `MethodMatcher` 是动态的吗？也就是说，即使 `MethodMatcher.matches(Method, Class)` 返回了 `true`，是否仍然需要在运行时通过 `MethodMatcher.matches(Method, Class, Object[])` 方法进行最终检查？

must have matched statically.
items.translation: 检查此方法是否存在运行时（动态）匹配，该匹配必须已在静态时完成。
